plugin.name: Scarface Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skip legal screens, intro movies and the press-to-start screen.
ControllerPrompts.description: Show keyboard or gamepad prompts for the device used last. Needs the bundled Xidi.
GamepadIcons.description: Select Xbox 360, Xbox One, PS3, PS4, PS5, Switch, Steam Deck or Steam Controller button icons.
ScrollWeaponsWithMouseWheel.description: Scroll weapons with the mouse wheel.
VehicleCameraRecenterDelay.description: Seconds after you last turned the vehicle camera with the mouse or stick before it turns back behind the vehicle. 0 turns it back at once.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto uses the whole screen width: HUD elements at the sides go to the screen's edges. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps them in a centered box of that aspect.
RestoreCharacterBlood.description: Restore the blood on characters from the PS2 version.
ConsoleGamma.description: Use the console gamma curve for deeper colors and more contrast.
FixAnimationDelta.description: Let animations run at frame rates above 60.
FixRageDepletion.description: Rage drains at the same speed at any frame rate.
FixMortarForce.description: Mortar shots fly the same at any frame rate.
FixRecoilRange.description: Use the weapon's real maximum recoil.
camera.fovfactor.description: Multiplies the field of view of the on-foot and vehicle cameras. Scripted cameras, aiming and the sniper zoom keep theirs.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window with a frame at the chosen resolution, or borderless at the desktop resolution. Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and the last window mode.
RawInputMouse.description: Read the mouse directly for the camera and the map: no pointer acceleration and no lost movement at the screen's edges. Off uses the cursor.
MouseSensitivity.description: Multiplies the game's mouse sensitivity for the camera and the map.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game and its sound while its window isn't active. Off keeps it running in the background.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: How the movies are shown on wider screens: the whole movie with black bars, filling the screen (cropped), or stretched.
CutsceneBorders.description: Letterbox keeps the original cinematic bars; Pillarbox keeps cinematics at their original aspect with bars at the sides. Off removes the bars without showing more of the scene.
FPSLimit.description: Limit the frame rate to a number from 30 to 1000 or to the monitor's refresh rate, or leave it unlimited. The game's vertical sync can set a lower limit.
FixVehicleCameraSmoothing.description: The vehicle camera follows the car the same at any frame rate.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the game window while the game is active. It is released when the game loses the focus, while the window is moved and at once when this is turned off.
AntiAliasing.description: SMAA anti-aliasing. Needs the game's own anti-aliasing to be off.
